decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system remains close to the firm's core spraying and protective-coating business, but as a relatively niche offer with lower website prominence its withdrawal risk is somewhat higher after two years on the market.
The low-pressure injection pump is a straightforward extension of the established portfolio and industrial customer base, so it is very likely to continue being supported.

Fire protection flow monitoring still fits the firm's push toward more future-oriented system solutions, but because it is somewhat more adjacent to the core equipment range it carries a moderate portfolio-pruning risk.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system is newly launched and closely aligned with the firm's core application technology, making an early withdrawal unlikely.
